name: Indian Link Chain Manufacturers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1958, Indian Link Chain Manufacturer Ltd does trading of Chains and Chemicals[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company was originally a chain manufacturer. It was engaged in the trading and distribution of steel chains & chemicals. But due to labour problems and uneconomical working, both the operations were closed and, at present, company is trying to develop trading business

cons: Stock is trading at 25.9 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of -2.65% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -46.3%
